lenders.why: Aave looks at the bitcoin alone, not the hedge: against $100,000 of it, it lends $56,667 at 5.08% a year, and sells if bitcoin falls 33.3%. Our pool lends the other $37,833 at 6.50%. Moving that bitcoin to Ethereum and back costs $690 ($560 there, $130 back), and Aave's lower rate saves $198 over 90 days, which doesn't cover it, so Aave isn't used: our pool lends the whole $94,500.

Rhea looks at the bitcoin alone, not the hedge: against $100,000 of it, it lends $50,667 at 16.70% a year, and sells if bitcoin falls 33.3%. Our pool lends the other $43,833 at 6.50%. Rhea costs more than our pool, so it isn't used: our pool lends the whole $94,500.
